_comment: The core-declared file form for chimera's project wizard: a PlayStation 2 project is one disc. The bios is not here - it is firmware, which the frontend resolves once and remembers, rather than something a project carries.

slots.title: Disc
slots.help: The DVD or CD image. A plain .iso or .bin (2048- or 2352-byte sectors, with or without a .cue beside it), or a compressed one: .chd, .cso, .zso, .gz. A PS2 project with no disc is a console sitting at its own browser, which is a machine worth booting - but the wizard asks for one, because a movie is usually of a game.
